Context: None

Question: Explain what the term (7/10) EOM means.

Options: 
A. A customer may deduct 7% of the amount of the invoice if payment is made no later than the tenth day after the end of the month
B. A customer may deduct 10% of the amount of the invoice if payment is made within 7 days of receiving the invoice
C. A customer may deduct 7% of the amount of the invoice if payment is made on the tenth day of the month
D. A customer must pay the full amount of the invoice within 7 days of the end of the month
E. A customer may deduct 10% of the amount of the invoice if payment is made no later than the seventh day after the end of the month
F. A customer may deduct 7% of the amount of the invoice if payment is made within 10 days of receiving the invoice
G. A customer may deduct 10% of the amount of the invoice if payment is made on the 7th day after the end of the month
H. A customer may deduct 7% of the amount of the invoice if payment is made on the 10th day of the month
I. A customer must pay the full amount of the invoice within 10 days of the end of the month
J. A customer may deduct 10% of the amount of the invoice if payment is made no later than the seventh day of the month

Provide the correct letter choice in \boxed{X}, where X is the correct letter choice. Keep the explanation or feedback within 3 sentences.
